messages:
Marco Diaz: Quick idea 12:05 fast HIIT + 20m proj bouldering at GravityWorks, then assemble lunch bowls in kitchen. Whos up for a sweat break? :sweat_smile:
Priya Singh: Love that. Can only do boulder after 12:20. Is the HIIT scalable for folks who prefer low impact?
Marco Diaz: Yep  modifications: low-impact circuit listed below. 5 rounds, 30s work/15s rest: air squats, plank shoulder taps, step-ups, band rows.
Elliot Zhao: In for both. Bringing a mini resistance band and a quick first-aid kit.
Nora Alvarez: I can come for boulder + lunch. Not doing HIIT today  knee twinge.
Ben Walsh: Ill lead the HIIT if folks want. 12:05 sharp in the wellness room. Low-impact option: march in place, wall pushups, seated band rows, glute bridges.
fitness-bot: Wellness-room booking confirmed 12:0012:30. Capacity 8. Reminder: wear non-marking shoes for climbing.
Marco Diaz: Thanks Ben + bot. Sign-up quick list:```
1) HIIT + boulder
2) HIIT only
3) Boulder + lunch
4) Lunch only / cheer squad
```
Priya Singh: 3
Elliot Zhao: 1
Nora Alvarez: 3
Ben Walsh: 1
Marco Diaz: 1 (Ill bring a small towel + water)
Priya Singh: Ill bring a banana bread (nut-free) and a jar of peanut butter for those who want it. Labeling please.
Nora Alvarez: Heads-up: my partner left a crashpad at the gym last week so well have one spare.
Elliot Zhao: Also chalk and a 2m roll of tape for skin.
Marco Diaz: Safety note: warm up ankles + shoulders for 8 minutes before sending anything. Keep spotters on slab moves.
Ben Walsh: Quick poll: should we time a 3-move topout challenge for fun? 1 = yes 2 = nah.
Priya Singh: 1
Nora Alvarez: 2 (I prefer project mode)
Elliot Zhao: 1
Marco Diaz: 1, but no pressure  its purely for laughs and one banana trophy.
fitness-bot: Hydration reminder: bring water bottle and label if sharing food.
Priya Singh: Noted. See you all at noon (or 12:20 for joiners).
Ben Walsh: See you  Ill Q the playlist. :headphones:
Marco Diaz: Final: if weather's weird we keep everything inside and skip river walk. Cool?
Nora Alvarez: Cool.
Elliot Zhao: Cool.
